sourceVintage.morth: Road Accidents in India 2024, calendar-year police returns
sourceVintage.who: Global status report on road safety 2023, India country profile; mortality values for 2021

sections.heading: Is the recorded toll falling?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: MoRTH Road Accidents in India 2024, Table 1.1, PDF p35; exact plotted rows are in the source-cell audit and fatalities.2020_2024 artifact.
sections.interpretationLimit: 2020 traffic affected by Covid; counts are not per-journey risk.

sections.heading: How many people die per reported accident?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: MoRTH Table 1.6, original PDF pp42–43, accidents, fatal accidents, fatalities and published severity for 2005–2024. The 2024 fatal-accident share (164,378/487,707=33.7%) and all 20 severity points were independently recomputed.
sections.interpretationLimit: People killed per 100 police-reported crash events is not the share of crashes that were fatal or per-trip risk; nonfatal reporting and Covid-era traffic can affect the series.

sections.heading: Who is being killed on India's roads?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: MoRTH Road Accidents in India 2024, Table 4.4, PDF p98; exact plotted rows are in the source-cell audit and road_users.2024 artifact.
sections.interpretationLimit: Victim category, not fault or risk per trip.

sections.heading: How do deaths differ for women and men?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: MoRTH Table 4.3, original PDF p93, Total row male 151,950 and female 25,225; Annexure 33 PDF p222 for pedestrian cross-reference.
sections.interpretationLimit: Recorded victim sex counts and within-sex pedestrian shares do not measure per-trip risk; report has two sex categories.

sections.heading: How old were the people who died?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: MoRTH Road Accidents in India 2024, Table 4.2, PDF p92; exact plotted rows are in the source-cell audit and ages.2024 artifact.
sections.interpretationLimit: Age distribution is not age-specific risk; unknown ages retained.

sections.heading: Is this mainly an urban toll?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: MoRTH Road Accidents in India 2024, Table 7.1, PDF p138; exact plotted rows are in the source-cell audit and rural_urban.2024 artifact.
sections.interpretationLimit: Crash area is not residence; old census population is not road travel.

sections.heading: Which kinds of roads carry the toll?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: MoRTH Road Accidents in India 2024, Table 2.1, PDF p54; exact plotted rows are in the source-cell audit and road_categories.2024 artifact.
sections.interpretationLimit: Road length is not traffic exposure; no causal road-class claim.

sections.heading: Which states account for the largest totals?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: MoRTH Road Accidents in India 2024, Table 5.6, PDF p110; exact plotted rows are in the source-cell audit and states_top_five.2024 artifact.
sections.interpretationLimit: Selected top five raw counts are not a safety league table.

sections.heading: How were fatal crashes classified?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: MoRTH Road Accidents in India 2024, Table 1.5, PDF p40; exact plotted rows are in the source-cell audit and collision_types.2024 artifact.
sections.interpretationLimit: Published labels mix geometry and circumstance; no cause inferred.

sections.heading: What does the report say about helmets and seatbelts?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: MoRTH Road Accidents in India 2024, Table 3.3, PDF p77; exact plotted rows are in the source-cell audit and safety_devices.2024 artifact.
sections.interpretationLimit: Recorded non-use is not the number of individually preventable deaths.

sections.heading: When are crashes recorded during the day?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: MoRTH Road Accidents in India 2024, Table 7.3, PDF p142; exact plotted rows are in the source-cell audit and time_of_day_accidents.2024 artifact.
sections.interpretationLimit: Accident counts, not deaths; unknown time retained; no hourly exposure.

sections.heading: How complete is the police record?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: WHO Global status report on road safety 2023, India country profile, Burden: road traffic fatalities, PDF p1; exact plotted rows are in the source-cell audit and who_reported_estimated.2021 artifact.
sections.interpretationLimit: Modelled 2021 estimate is not an identified missing-death list or 2024 multiplier.

sections.heading: What can these figures say about prevention?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: MoRTH Tables 1.1, 4.4, 4.5 and Section 10, PDF pp160–162.
sections.interpretationLimit: Concentrations direct investigation but do not establish the effect of a specific intervention.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers: methodology and caveats
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: Raw PDF hashes, source-cell audit, original MoRTH table pages and WHO India 2021 profile.
sections.interpretationLimit: Only article cells are source-verified; the full SpaceBunny transcription remains a draft.

releaseChecks.publicationDecision: Approved for the authorised push to main; deployment is verified after the workflow completes.
releaseChecks.independentFactCheck: MiMo 2.6 Flash via OpenCode Go adversarially reviewed the revised article against original PDF pp35, 42–43 and 93. It confirmed the 2005–24 severity arithmetic and 2024 sex split, suggested stating the 2021 severity peak and distinguishing fatal-accident share, and questioned a borderline rounding pair. The original Annexure 33 counts give exactly 7,471/36,526=20.4539% and 7,471/25,225=29.6174%, correctly rounded to 20.5% and 29.6%. Other article cells remain covered by the independent source-cell audit, because the MiMo packet did not contain every source page.
releaseChecks.proseReview: MiMo 2.6 Flash via OpenCode Go, followed by source-checked editorial revision; standalone openings name the ministry and Road Accidents in India 2024.
